mf:std:ai_discovery:mainframe_ai_discove.summary: Setup environment markers in shell profile

mf:std:ai_discovery:mainframe_ai_discove.summary: Setup universal AI discovery (works with any AI tool)

mf:std:output:mainframe_call.summary: Invoke any MAINFRAME function with automatic USOP wrapping Captures stdout, stderr, exit code, and wraps in JSON envelope

mf:std:introspect:mainframe_capabilities.name: mainframe_capabilities
mf:std:introspect:mainframe_capabilities.summary: mainframe_capabilities - List available categories and counts

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm.name: mainframe_confirm
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm.summary: Interactive yes/no confirmation prompt. Respects _MAINFRAME_CONFIRM_MODE for auto-approve/deny in CI/testing environments.
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm.signature: if mainframe_confirm "Deploy to production?"; then deploy; fi

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_auto_.name: mainframe_confirm_auto_approve
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_auto_.summary: Force auto-approve mode. All confirmations return 0 without prompting. Useful for CI/testing environments where interactive input is unavailable.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_auto_.name: mainframe_confirm_auto_deny
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_auto_.summary: Force auto-deny mode. All confirmations return 1 without prompting. Useful for CI/testing environments to verify denial paths.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_batch.name: mainframe_confirm_batch
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_batch.summary: Show a batch of commands and confirm all-or-nothing. User sees the full list before making a single decision.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_count.name: mainframe_confirm_count
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_count.summary: Return the number of entries in the confirmation history.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_last.name: mainframe_confirm_last
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_last.summary: Show the most recent confirmation decision.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_log.name: mainframe_confirm_log
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_log.summary: Show the full confirmation history as a JSON array. Each entry contains timestamp, message, decision, and method.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_polic.name: mainframe_confirm_policy
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_polic.summary: Set the confirmation policy for subsequent operations. always - always prompt for confirmation never  - auto-approve everything (dangerous for production) risk   - use risk scoring to decide (requires risk.sh)

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_reset.name: mainframe_confirm_reset
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_reset.summary: Reset to interactive mode. Confirmations will prompt via /dev/tty. Also resets policy to "always" and threshold to 5.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_risk.name: mainframe_confirm_risk
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_risk.summary: Auto-approve if the command's risk score is below the threshold. If mainframe_risk_score is available (from risk.sh), uses it for scoring. Falls back to always-ask if risk.sh is not loaded.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_statu.name: mainframe_confirm_status
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_statu.summary: Show current confirmation module status including mode, policy, threshold, and history count.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_thres.name: mainframe_confirm_threshold
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_thres.summary: Set the risk threshold for auto-approve in risk-based policy mode. Commands with risk scores below this threshold are auto-approved. Commands at or above this threshold require interactive confirmation.

mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_timeo.name: mainframe_confirm_timeout
mf:agent:confirm:mainframe_confirm_timeo.summary: Confirmation with a timeout. If the user does not respond within the specified number of seconds, the request is automatically denied.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_c.name: mainframe_context_custom
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_c.summary: Define a custom context profile with specified rules. RULES_JSON format: {"risk_threshold":N,"confirm_policy":"...","limits":"...","dry_run":BOOL} Simple key=value pairs also accepted: "risk_threshold=7 confirm_policy=risk limits=moderate dry_run=false"

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_d.name: mainframe_context_detect
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_d.summary: Auto-detect the deployment context from environment variables and hostname patterns. Detection priority: 1. CI=true or GITHUB_ACTIONS=true -> "ci" 2. NODE_ENV=production or MAINFRAME_ENV=production -> "production" 3. NODE_ENV=test or MAINFRAME_ENV=testing -> "testing" 4. Hostname contains "staging" or "stg" -> "staging" 5. Default -> "development"

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_e.name: mainframe_context_enforce
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_e.summary: Enforce the current profile by setting the corresponding MAINFRAME_* environment variables that other modules (risk.sh, etc.) respect.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_g.name: mainframe_context_get
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_g.summary: Get the name of the currently active context profile.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_i.name: mainframe_context_is
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_i.summary: Check if the current context matches the specified profile.
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_i.signature: if mainframe_context_is development; then echo "dev mode"; fi

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_l.name: mainframe_context_list
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_l.summary: List all available context profiles (built-in and custom).

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_o.name: mainframe_context_override
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_o.summary: Temporarily override a single rule in the current profile. Overrides persist until mainframe_context_reset is called.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.name: mainframe_context_require
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.summary: Require that the current context matches the expected profile. Useful as a guard at the top of production-only or development-only scripts.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.name: mainframe_context_reset
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.summary: Reset all overrides and revert to the base profile defaults. If no profile is set, clears all state entirely.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.name: mainframe_context_rules
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_r.summary: Display the rules for a given profile (or current if omitted) as JSON.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_s.name: mainframe_context_set
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_s.summary: Set the active context profile, applying its safety parameters.

mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_s.name: mainframe_context_status
mf:agent:safecontext:mainframe_context_s.summary: Display comprehensive status of the context system including active profile, effective rules (with overrides applied), override list, and enforcement state.

mf:std:compat:mainframe_deprecated.name: mainframe_deprecated
mf:std:compat:mainframe_deprecated.summary: Warn once that a public symbol is deprecated. Set MAINFRAME_COMPAT_WARNINGS=0 to suppress compatibility warnings.

mf:std:introspect:mainframe_describe.name: mainframe_describe
mf:std:introspect:mainframe_describe.summary: mainframe_describe - Get full documentation for a function

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_dryrun_enabled.name: mainframe_dryrun_enabled
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_dryrun_enabled.summary: Check whether dry-run mode is currently enabled.

mf:agent:contract:mainframe_error.name: mainframe_error
mf:agent:contract:mainframe_error.summary: Emit a structured error with code, message, calling function, file, and line. AI agents parse this JSON to understand failures and take corrective action.

mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_category.name: mainframe_error_category
mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_category.summary: Get the category for an error code based on its numeric range.

mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_list.name: mainframe_error_list
mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_list.summary: List all error codes, optionally filtered by category. Output format: CODE  NAME  MESSAGE

mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_msg.name: mainframe_error_msg
mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_msg.summary: Get the human-readable message for an error code.

mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_suggest.name: mainframe_error_suggest
mf:std:errors:mainframe_error_suggest.summary: Get the recovery suggestion for an error code. Suggestions are actionable - they tell the AI agent exactly what to call.

mf:std:hints:mainframe_hint.name: mainframe_hint
mf:std:hints:mainframe_hint.summary: Get hint for a function (returns suggested next functions) Output: format_bytes,file_lines,read_file

mf:std:hints:mainframe_hint_category.name: mainframe_hint_category
mf:std:hints:mainframe_hint_category.summary: Get the category a function belongs to Output: git

mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_chain.name: mainframe_hints_chain
mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_chain.summary: Show chain of hints starting from a function Output: git_branch -> git_commit_hash -> git_commit_message -> trim_string git_branch -> git_commit_hash -> git_commit_author -> git_commit_date git_branch -> git_commit_hash -> git_log_oneline -> git_changed_since git_branch -> git_is_dirty -> git_changed_files -> array_length ...

mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_count.name: mainframe_hints_count
mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_count.summary: Count total number of hints in the database

mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_for.name: mainframe_hints_for
mf:std:hints:mainframe_hints_for.summary: List all hints in a category Output: git_branch -> git_commit_hash,git_is_dirty,git_log_oneline git_is_dirty -> git_changed_files,git_status_short,git_has_staged ...

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_check.name: mainframe_limit_check
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_check.summary: Check whether a specific limit has been exceeded. For time limits, calculates elapsed time since init.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_depth.name: mainframe_limit_depth
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_depth.summary: Set the maximum recursion or nesting depth.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_enforce.name: mainframe_limit_enforce
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_enforce.summary: Run a command only if the current limits allow it. Checks all active limits (those with max > 0) before executing. Increments the files counter by 1 after successful execution.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_files.name: mainframe_limit_files
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_files.summary: Set the maximum number of file operations (open, read, write, delete) allowed.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_incremen.name: mainframe_limit_increment
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_incremen.summary: Increment a usage counter. Used to track resource consumption.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_init.name: mainframe_limit_init
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_init.summary: Initialize the limits tracking system. Creates a temporary directory for counter files and marks the system as active.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_is_enabl.name: mainframe_limit_is_enabled
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_is_enabl.summary: Check if the limits system is currently active.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_network.name: mainframe_limit_network
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_network.summary: Set the maximum number of network operations allowed.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_remainin.name: mainframe_limit_remaining
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_remainin.summary: Show the remaining quota for a specific limit type. Prints "unlimited" if no limit is set (max=0).

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_reset.name: mainframe_limit_reset
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_reset.summary: Reset usage counters. With no argument, resets all counters. With a type argument, resets only that counter.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_status.name: mainframe_limit_status
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_status.summary: Display status of all limits with current usage and maximums.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_time.name: mainframe_limit_time
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_time.summary: Set the maximum execution time in seconds.

mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_writes.name: mainframe_limit_writes
mf:agent:limits:mainframe_limit_writes.summary: Set the maximum total write volume allowed. Accepts human-readable sizes.

mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_doctor.name: mainframe_pi_doctor
mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_doctor.summary: Opinionated, exact-version/platform Pi diagnosis. This path reads Pi's package manifest and MAINFRAME's evidence policy but deliberately never starts Pi. Consequently it never claims that a live process is ready.

mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_install.name: mainframe_pi_install
mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_install.summary: Transactionally migrate legacy Pi resources and activate this Mainframe root as an absolute local Pi package source. Real mutation requires same-command --yes; environment variables never authorize it.

mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_remove.name: mainframe_pi_remove
mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_remove.summary: Transactionally detach only the exact current/receipted Mainframe package sources.  Historical migration backups, legacy resources, and unrelated Pi settings are deliberately left untouched.

mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_restore.name: mainframe_pi_restore
mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_restore.summary: Exact recovery for a completed legacy-to-package migration whose subsequent live Pi verification failed. The implementation is loaded only on demand so ordinary status, doctor, install, and remove paths stay small.

mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_status.name: mainframe_pi_status
mf:std:pi:mainframe_pi_status.summary: Read-only inspection of the first-party Pi package and legacy integration. Returns zero for a valid inspected configuration, including not-installed or migration-needed states. Unsafe paths, permissions, or invalid JSON fail.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_add.name: mainframe_plan_add
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_add.summary: Record a planned operation. In dry-run mode, records but does not execute. In normal mode, executes immediately and records for audit trail.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_clear.name: mainframe_plan_clear
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_clear.summary: Clear all recorded plan steps and reset the counter.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_count.name: mainframe_plan_count
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_count.summary: Print the number of currently recorded plan steps.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_execute.name: mainframe_plan_execute
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_execute.summary: Execute the recorded plan. With --confirm, displays the plan and waits for user confirmation before proceeding. With --step N, executes only that step. With --continue-on-error, does not abort on first failure.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_export.name: mainframe_plan_export
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_export.summary: Export the plan to a file or stdout. Uses MAINFRAME_PLAN_FORMAT for formatting.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_remove.name: mainframe_plan_remove
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_remove.summary: Remove a specific step from the plan by its step number.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_reorder.name: mainframe_plan_reorder
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_reorder.summary: Move a step from one position to another, shifting other steps accordingly.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_results.name: mainframe_plan_results
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_results.summary: Display the success/failure status of each executed step.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_risk_summ.name: mainframe_plan_risk_summary
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_risk_summ.summary: Show aggregate risk information: total score, max score, and distribution across risk levels. Useful for approval gates.

mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_show.name: mainframe_plan_show
mf:agent:dryrun:mainframe_plan_show.summary: Display the current plan in the specified format.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_assess.name: mainframe_risk_assess
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_assess.summary: Return a full risk assessment as a JSON object including score, level, command, target, reasons array, and actionable suggestion.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_check.name: mainframe_risk_check
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_check.summary: Check a command against the current risk threshold. Operations scoring above MAINFRAME_RISK_THRESHOLD are blocked.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_explain.name: mainframe_risk_explain
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_explain.summary: Provide a detailed, human-readable explanation of why a command has its risk score, including all contributing factors and the suggestion.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_is_destruct.name: mainframe_risk_is_destructive
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_is_destruct.summary: Quick check: is this command destructive (score >= 6)?

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_is_safe.name: mainframe_risk_is_safe
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_is_safe.summary: Quick check: is this command safe (score 0-2)?

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_label.name: mainframe_risk_label
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_label.summary: Convert a numeric risk score to its human-readable label.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_max.name: mainframe_risk_max
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_max.summary: Compare multiple commands and return the riskiest one. Each command should be a quoted string.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_require_con.name: mainframe_risk_require_confirm
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_require_con.summary: Determine whether a command requires user confirmation based on its risk score.

mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_score.name: mainframe_risk_score
mf:agent:risk:mainframe_risk_score.summary: Calculate and return the risk score for a command with its arguments. Uses pattern matching on command name, path arguments, and flags.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_cm.name: mainframe_scope_add_cmd
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_cm.summary: Add a single command to the commands scope without replacing existing entries.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_ho.name: mainframe_scope_add_host
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_ho.summary: Add a single host/CIDR to the network scope without replacing existing entries.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_pa.name: mainframe_scope_add_path
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_add_pa.summary: Add a single directory to the filesystem scope without replacing existing entries.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check.name: mainframe_scope_check
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check.summary: Check if a target is within the defined scope for a given type. If no scope is set for the type, all operations are allowed (open scope).

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.name: mainframe_scope_check_cmd
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.summary: Convenience wrapper to check command scope.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.name: mainframe_scope_check_host
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.summary: Convenience wrapper to check network scope for a host.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.name: mainframe_scope_check_path
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_check_.summary: Convenience wrapper to check filesystem scope for a path.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_clear.name: mainframe_scope_clear
mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_clear.summary: Clear scope boundaries. If type is provided, clear only that type. If no type is provided, clear all scopes.

mf:security:scope:mainframe_scope_destro.name: mainframe_scope_destroy

mf:std:tirith_inject:tirith_check_bidi_c.name: tirith_check_bidi_controls

mf:std:tirith_url:tirith_check_confusabl.name: tirith_check_confusable_domain
mf:std:tirith_url:tirith_check_confusabl.summary: tirith_check_confusable_domain URL [SOURCE] Detect domains that look like well-known domains via confusable characters Uses skeleton comparison and Levenshtein distance (if fuzzy.sh loaded)

mf:std:tirith_inject:tirith_check_contro.name: tirith_check_control_chars
mf:std:tirith_inject:tirith_check_contro.summary: tirith_check_control_chars INPUT [SOURCE] Detect ASCII control characters that should not appear in normal input. Checks for \x00-\x08 and \x0e-\x1f, excluding tab (\x09), newline (\x0a), and carriage return (\x0d) which are legitimate whitespace. Severity: high | Rule: ControlChars

mf:std:tirith_ecosystem:tirith_check_doc.name: tirith_check_docker_registry
mf:std:tirith_ecosystem:tirith_check_doc.summary: tirith_check_docker_registry CMD [SOURCE] Detect docker pull, docker run, or FROM in Dockerfiles using untrusted container registries. mf:std:tirith_ecosystem:tirith_check_git.name: tirith_check_git_typosquat

Extracts org/repo from the clone URL and compares against popular repos using levenshtein_distance from fuzzy.sh. Flags repos with edit distance 1-2 from a popular repo (close but not exact match). Severity: medium | Rule: GitTyposquat

mf:std:tirith_inject:tirith_check_hidden.name: tirith_check_hidden_multiline
mf:std:tirith_inject:tirith_check_hidden.summary: tirith_check_hidden_multiline INPUT [SOURCE] Detect hidden newlines or carriage returns that conceal additional commands within a seemingly single-line input. Severity: medium | Rule: NpmUrlInstall

Severity: medium | Rule: PipUrlInstall

Initialize audit log system Options: --output PATH      Path to audit log file (default: /var/log/audit.jsonl) --sign BOOL        Enable cryptographic signing (default: false) --hmac-key KEY     HMAC key for signing (required if --sign true) --session-id ID    Session ID for context (auto-generated if not provided) --retention DAYS   Retention period in days (default: 90)

Rotate the audit log when it exceeds AUDIT_MAX_BYTES, keeping AUDIT_KEEP numbered generations (file.1 = most recent archive). Compare two commands for equality if commands_equal "cat file1 | sort" "cat file2 | sort"; then echo "Files have same content" fi Security: Uses subprocess isolation via bash -c
Read first N lines from command into array read_n_lines_from "cat largefile.txt" 10 first_lines echo "First 10 lines: ${first_lines[*]}" Security: Uses subprocess isolation via bash -c

Process lines in batches process_batch() { local -n batch_ref=$1 local batch_num=$2 echo "Processing batch $batch_num of ${#batch_ref[@]} items" printf '%s\n' "${batch_ref[@]}" } batch_lines_from "seq 1 10" 3 process_batch Notes: - Callback receives batch array name as $1, batch_num as $2 - callback MUST be a function name (not arbitrary code) Security: Validates callback is a function, uses subprocess for command
Interleave output from two commands interleave_commands "echo -e 'a\nb'" "echo -e '1\n2'" merged echo "${merged[@]}"  # a 1 b 2 Security: Uses subprocess isolation via bash -c

tirith_init Initialize the tirith subsystem: set up shared state, load config. Safe to call multiple times (idempotent).

tirith_load_config [FILE] Load tirith configuration from a YAML-like file. Format: version: 1 fail_mode: open allowlist: - *.trusted.com - github.com blocklist: - evil.com severity_overrides: RawIpUrl: low ShortenedUrl: high
tirith_check_proxy_env [SOURCE] Check if proxy environment variables are set, which could redirect traffic. Severity: low | Rule: ProxyEnvSet
tirith_scan_command CMD [SOURCE] Full security scan of a shell command string. Runs injection, pipe, path, URL, and ecosystem checks.
tirith_scan_url URL [SOURCE] Full security scan of a single URL.
tirith_scan_input TEXT [SOURCE] Scan arbitrary text for injection attacks.
tirith_url_trust_score URL Calculate a trust score for a URL on a 0-100 scale. Higher score = more trustworthy. Output: Integer score on stdout
tirith_report Print a human-readable report of all findings to stderr.
tirith_report_json Output all findings as a JSON object on stdout.
tirith_audit_log CMD RESULT [EXTRA] Append a JSONL entry to the audit log.
tirith_clear Reset all findings and counters.
tirith_has_findings [SEVERITY] Check if there are any findings, optionally of a specific severity.
tirith_should_block Determine if current findings warrant blocking execution. In "closed" mode: block on HIGH or CRITICAL In "open" mode: block only on CRITICAL

tirith_check_docker_registry CMD [SOURCE] Detect docker pull, docker run, or FROM in Dockerfiles using untrusted container registries. Docker Hub images without a registry prefix (e.g. nginx:latest) are considered safe. Severity: medium | Rule: DockerUntrustedRegistry

tirith_check_pip_url_install CMD [SOURCE] Detect pip install from URLs rather than PyPI. Flags direct URL installs (https://, http://, git+https://) and --index-url pointing to non-PyPI domains. Normal PyPI installs (pip install package-name) are not flagged. Severity: medium | Rule: PipUrlInstall

tirith_check_npm_url_install CMD [SOURCE] Detect npm install from URLs or git repos. Flags direct URL installs (https://..., git+..., github:user/repo) and npm config set registry pointing to non-standard registries. Normal npm installs are not flagged. Severity: medium | Rule: NpmUrlInstall

tirith_check_web3_rpc CMD [SOURCE] Detect hardcoded Web3 RPC endpoints in commands. Looks for URLs containing known web3 provider domains and common RPC path patterns with hex API keys. Severity: low | Rule: Web3RpcEndpoint

tirith_check_web3_address CMD [SOURCE] Detect Ethereum-style addresses (0x followed by 40 hex chars) in commands. This is informational -- flags hardcoded blockchain addresses. Severity: low | Rule: Web3AddressInUrl

tirith_check_git_typosquat CMD [SOURCE] Detect git clone with potentially typosquatted repository names. Extracts org/repo from the clone URL and compares against popular repos using levenshtein_distance from fuzzy.sh. Flags repos with edit distance 1-2 from a popular repo (close but not exact match). Severity: medium | Rule: GitTyposquat
tirith_scan_ecosystem CMD [SOURCE] Run all 6 ecosystem security checks on the input command.
tirith_hook_install Install the tirith preexec hook using the bash DEBUG trap. Chains with any existing DEBUG trap rather than replacing it.
tirith_hook_uninstall Remove the tirith preexec hook and restore the original DEBUG trap.
tirith_hook_status Print the current hook status.
tirith_hook_toggle Toggle the hook on/off without installing/uninstalling the trap.

tirith_check_ansi_escapes INPUT [SOURCE] Detect ANSI escape sequences that could manipulate terminal display. Checks for CSI (\x1b[), 8-bit CSI (\x9b), OSC (\x1b]), SS2 (\x1bN), and SS3 (\x1bO) sequences. Severity: high | Rule: AnsiEscapes

tirith_check_control_chars INPUT [SOURCE] Detect ASCII control characters that should not appear in normal input. Checks for \x00-\x08 and \x0e-\x1f, excluding tab (\x09), newline (\x0a), and carriage return (\x0d) which are legitimate whitespace. Severity: high | Rule: ControlChars

tirith_check_bidi_controls INPUT [SOURCE] Detect Unicode BiDi (bidirectional) control characters that can reorder displayed text to hide malicious code (CVE-2021-42574, "Trojan Source"). Severity: critical | Rule: BidiControls
tirith_check_zero_width INPUT [SOURCE] Detect zero-width Unicode characters that can hide content or alter string comparisons without visible change. Severity: high | Rule: ZeroWidthChars

tirith_check_hidden_multiline INPUT [SOURCE] Detect hidden newlines or carriage returns that conceal additional commands within a seemingly single-line input. Only flags when a newline is followed by a dangerous command keyword. Severity: high | Rule: HiddenMultiline
tirith_scan_injection INPUT [SOURCE] Run all 5 injection detection rules on the input.
tirith_strip_dangerous_chars INPUT Strip BiDi controls, zero-width characters, and control characters (keeping tab, newline, and carriage return) from the input. Output: Cleaned string on stdout
